scientific_integrity: Gvozdevsky is credited for the lexicographic-product isotypy theorem and quotient rigidity; Friedman--Stanley are credited for Borel completeness of countable linear orders. The retained contribution is the exact Borel isotypy-class identification and reduction synthesis. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns one particular isotypy class of countable linear orders. It does not classify other isotypy classes and may be a short uncatalogued consequence known to specialists.
title: Borel completeness inside one isotypy class of countable linear orders
